Chapter 317 - 317 Return; Choose a Car!

317 Return; Choose a Car!

Today’s lunch was made by Grandma.

It had to be said that Su Ningjing’s and Grandma’s cooking skills were passed down from generation to generation.

Chili fried meat, tomato egg soup, hot and sour shredded potatoes, cucumber ham, leek scrambled eggs…

The dishes were very simple, but they were all very delicious.

Lin Fan ate two big bowls of rice during this meal and was extremely satisfied.

He took advantage of the fact that Grandma and Ah Mei were here and repeated his previous thoughts.

“Grandma, Sis, are you willing to live in the city?”

Ah Mei looked at the old lady in confusion, then at Su Ningjing.

Su Ningjing bit her red lip and said, “Grandma, Sis, I want to bring you to the city… This way, it’ll be easier to take care of Grandma’s health. Ah Mei can also learn more and be able to study well in university in the future.”

Grandma first looked up at the mountains outside the window, then at the fields on the hillside.

After a while, she said, “You’re right…”

When Lin Fan and Su Ningjing heard this, their faces revealed a hint of joy.

Since they had already made their decision, they did not hesitate and quickly packed their luggage.

In fact, they did not have much to pack.

Grandma, Su Ningjing, and Ah Mei only packed some important things.

Then, they took a few sets of clothes.

The house was already very clean and tidy. Not long after, everything that needed to be taken away was packed up.

“Brother, if we leave, what about the coffee beans?”

Lin Fan patted her head and said, “After this, I’ll get people to come over and help with the management and planting. In addition, I’ll also get the villagers to help plant coffee plants.

“In the future, they can all eat a lot of delicious food.”

As the world’s largest coffee company, Magpie Coffee had the most experience in coffee cultivation. They could definitely use coffee to completely change the face of this place.

Ah Mei sat in the Porsche, looking at the old house and the flowing river. Her face was full of reluctance, and her whole person seemed listless.

A child’s mood seemed to be like rain. There could be many changes in a short time.

If it was not for the fact that no one else in the plane was speaking, Ah Mei would probably be jumping up and down in joy.

After arriving in Jiangbei…

Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz G parked at the airport and drove Su Ningjing, Ah Mei, and Grandma to a Michelin two-star restaurant. They spent 37,800 yuan and had a sumptuous and exquisite dinner. Then, he brought Grandma, Ah Mei, and Su Ningjing to Washington Mansion. It was a 156-square-meter luxurious house.

This was the first property that Lin Fan obtained from the system.

At the same time, it was also the best school district in Jiangbei. There were lakes and parks around. Be it shopping, transportation, or medical care, everything was convenient here.

Staying here would allow Ah Mei to get the best educational resources and give Grandma a better living environment.

In addition, it could also give Lin Fan and Su Ningjing more space to be alone.

This was definitely a choice that killed two birds with one stone.

That night, Lin Fan did not stay in Washington Mansion. He drove his Mercedes-Benz to Coiling Dragon Villa alone.

The next day…

When a warm ray of sunlight shone onto the balcony, Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes.

He first looked at his phone. There was a text message on the screen as usual.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,919,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

It was a few hundred thousand more than usual. Obviously, this was the result of picking fruits and walking in the mountains yesterday.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan did not pay too much attention to it. He placed his attention on the check-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,000,000 yuan.]

Lin Fan yawned and walked out slowly.

As soon as he opened the door, a fragrance that whetted one’s appetite filled the air.

Lin Fan focused his gaze and saw that there were already lean meat noodles, eggs, milk, and other food on the dining table.

At this moment, Su Ningjing walked over from the kitchen with a plate of fried dumplings.

Lin Fan looked at her peaceful and gentle face and smiled, “When did you arrive? What about Grandma and Ah Mei?”

“They’re shopping. I thought you probably haven’t had breakfast yet, so I came over to make some for you.”

Lin Fan nodded. “It smells so good! Have you eaten? Eat with me.”

“Alright,” Su Ningjing said.

This breakfast might not be as luxurious as the food served in the Michelin restaurant, but the taste was just as good.

Lin Fan finished all the food and was extremely satisfied.

He wiped his mouth and said, “I’m full. It’s time to exercise.

“Last time in my hometown, we couldn’t make too much of a commotion. It doesn’t matter today.”

As he spoke, he pulled Su Ningjing into his arms.

Su Ningjing blushed and said softly, “No, no, no. We can’t take too long… Grandma and Sis are still waiting for us…”

…

It was noon when they were done, and sweat dripped down their bodies.

Who knew it was such hard work?

….

About two hours later, Lin Fan and Su Ningjing slowly walked out of the villa.

“Oh right, Ningjing, do you have a driver’s license?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes, I do,” Su Ningjing said.

“Then go ahead and pick a car.” Lin Fan pulled Su Ningjing’s slender hand and walked toward a long row of cars parked in the distance.

These were the cars that the chairman had sent over after Lin Fan obtained 5% of Volkswagen Group’s shares.

Volkswagen Group had more than ten brands, including Volkswagen, Audi, Skoda, Bentley, Bugatti, Lamborghini, Porsche, Ducati, and so on.

At that time, the chairman of Volkswagen sent one car from each brand.

However, Lin Fan had only driven the Santana when he was doing a mission. He had never used any of the other cars.

“You can drive whichever car you like,” Lin Fan said.

Su Ningjing looked at the long row of cars and was a little stunned.

She knew that Lin Fan was rich, but she did not expect him to have so many cars. There must be dozens of them, right?

There were so many cars. Could he drive all of them?

When Lin Fan saw that Su Ningjing had not chosen, he thought that she was a little embarrassed.

He pointed at the Lamborghini Urus in front of him and said, “This car has good horsepower and is spacious… It’ll be easier for you to drive it, and it’ll be more comfortable for Grandma and Sis to sit in. The trunk space is good, and you can store things in the future.”

Many people felt that women should drive small cars. Whether it was driving or parking, it would be safer and simpler.

However, Lin Fan did not think that way.

As long as Su Ningjing drove a Lamborghini Urus, would anyone dare to hit her?

The other cars on the street would deliberately keep a distance from it.

As for the trouble of parking?

One had to know…

The entire building of Washington Mansion belonged to Lin Fan. There were hundreds of parking spaces. There were horizontal, vertical, and slanted ones. She could park however she wanted. Would it be troublesome?
